findings.text: Declaring a binary `input_file` leaves the consuming library free to reuse stale build products after an SQL edit unless the input contributes to its build trace. Fix: Require each consuming library to list the binary input in `needs` or otherwise include it in the module’s trace.

Even with the input in `needs`, Lake hashes the file before elaboration, so an edit after Lake checks the trace can leave an accepted build product stale. Fix: State that the Lake option requires stable SQL inputs from the trace check through snapshot acceptance, or require a comparison against the hash of the bytes elaboration read.
